audience: Dutch small business owners and bookkeepers who keep their accounts in e-Boekhouden

useCases.title: See which invoices are still unpaid
useCases.text: The AI lists open invoices, either debtors (customers who owe you) or creditors (bills you still have to pay), and adds up the outstanding amount.

useCases.title: Find the invoices created for a customer
useCases.text: The AI searches invoices by invoice number, relation or date range and opens one with its items and amounts.

useCases.title: Check ledger balances for a period
useCases.text: The AI reads the balance of one ledger or of all ledgers (a trial balance), for a period and optionally per cost center.

useCases.title: Review bookings of a type
useCases.text: The AI searches mutations by type, such as invoices received or money sent, and opens one with its ledger, VAT code, amount and relation rows.

useCases.title: Add or update a customer or supplier
useCases.text: The AI creates a new relation (customer or supplier) with name and details, or changes fields of an existing one. Fields you leave out keep their values.
